cands.bio: Republican elected to Alabama House District 48. Federal prosecutor in the U.S. Attorney's Office in Birmingham since 2003, where he managed teams of prosecutors. Also worked in his family's corrugated box manufacturing company, which employed over 100 people. Cumberland School of Law graduate.
cands.gaps: We found no record of his positions on data centers, development or growth, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land ownership, H-1B or immigration enforcement, guns, abortion, or school choice and vouchers. His campaign site pledges tax cuts and returning excess revenue to taxpayers, but says nothing specific about homestead taxes. Its education section is general, and part of that page was cut off. His year of graduation, where he grew up, and how long he has lived in District 48 are not stated. His prosecution record comes only from his own campaign site, with no independent reporting. We found no endorsements, no controversies, and no foreign ties. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and his Wikipedia page is only a stub.
